verdict.rationale: Relay's docs confirm card issuance with spend limits, role definitions, real-time transaction tracking, and multi-step approval rules (relay-docs-2, relay-docs-16, relay-docs-17), directly supporting granular per-card controls for employees. However, community reviews note occasional 'problems with prescribed limits' and permission glitches (relay-comm-2), and hard caps like a $7,000 daily card limit (relay-comm-4) suggest some inflexibility. Missing for 10: deeper documentation on category/merchant-level restrictions, audit trails for limit changes, and independent confirmation that granular controls work flawlessly at scale.
